therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Inhibition of BCR-ABL protein that converts bone marrow stem cells from normal to leukemic
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with chronic phase chronic myeloid leukemia with suboptimal response to imatinib

results.target_engagement_evidence: MMolR defined as reduction in BCR-ABL transcript levels of at least 3 log
biomarker_changes: BCR-ABL transcript level reduction measured for MMolR
safety_signals: Skin rash higher with dasatinib (42.1% vs 15.4%)
Fluid retention lower with dasatinib (5.3% vs 38.5%)
Superficial edema lower with dasatinib (0% vs 30.8%)
Pneumonia, skin burning sensation, breast cancer reported with dasatinib
Melaena and haematemesis reported with imatinib
results.dose_information: Dasatinib 100 mg once daily orally vs Imatinib 400 mg twice daily orally with meals

context.comparator: Imatinib 800 mg daily (400 mg twice daily)
context.duration: 12 months treatment with follow-up to 24 months
